Prepare BPCells Counts for edgeR GLM Workflows

bp_prepare_dge.Rd

Runs the canonical first-stage edgeR workflow on a BPCells-backed count matrix: optional expression filtering, recomputation of post-filter library sizes, and TMM normalization.

Usage

bp_prepare_dge(
  y,
  design = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  filter = TRUE,
  norm.method = c("TMM", "none"),
  block.size = 1000,
  workers = 1,
  verbose = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

y

A genes-by-samples count matrix.

design

Optional design matrix passed to bp_filter_by_expr().

group

Optional group factor passed to bp_filter_by_expr().

filter

Logical scalar. If TRUE, apply bp_filter_by_expr().

norm.method

Normalization method passed to bp_calc_norm_factors().

block.size

Number of rows to process per block while filtering.

workers

Number of row blocks or normalization columns to process in parallel for supported steps.

verbose

Logical scalar. If TRUE, emit low-noise progress messages from supported preparation steps.

...

Additional arguments passed to bp_filter_by_expr().

Value

A list with the filtered matrix, keep mask, library sizes, normalization factors, effective library sizes, log offsets, and sample metadata.
